contract_conformance.notes: contracts/types.ts byte-identical to lib/types.ts (verified). All API routes return the documented ApiOk<T> envelope. Server actions match contracts/api.md signatures exactly. Domain rule #5 (preserve user tags on rescan) initially failed integration; root-caused to mapRawRepoRow oversight in raw-SELECT sites and fixed.

test_coverage.notes: 29 tests across 8 files: 24 pass, 5 skipped (live-API conformance, gated on E2E_BASE_URL). Coverage of all backend modules (db schema/queries, scanner, heuristic tagger, hybrid search, server actions, contract parity). Playwright E2E specs ready (catalog/search/keyboard) but not executed in this session — orchestrator prefers manual user-driven UI validation.

security.notes: Zod validation on all server-action and route inputs. ApiError envelopes never leak stack traces. SQL is fully parameterized via better-sqlite3 prepare() and Drizzle. No secrets logged. openInEditor uses execFile (not exec) to avoid shell injection. No raw-HTML injection sinks. Local-only app, no auth surface.

code_quality.notes: Strict TS, zero ts-ignore. Single source of truth for types. Clean separation: lib/db | lib/git | lib/embed | lib/search | lib/tag. Components driven by CSS variables; no hardcoded colors. Keyboard shortcuts respect editable-element guard and prefers-reduced-motion. Two minor leftover bits flagged in issues.

issues.description: Hybrid search returned empty for 'next' against a freshly-scanned repo whose only signal was a heuristic tag. Likely FTS5 query quoting + Ollama unavailable causing the fallback path to under-match. Recommend wrapping the user query for FTS5 with snippet-friendly tokenization. Unit tests for hybrid search pass with mocked embedding.

Two frontend interactions wired-but-not-fully-functional (per frontend agent's own report): Tag editing in DetailPanel manages local state but does not yet call setRepoTags on Enter/remove; New-Group dialog accepts a name but does not yet call createGroup. Both are one-call fixes pending a router.refresh() pattern.

Backend exposes RepoRow (Drizzle row) from app/actions/repos.ts. Not consumed by frontend; should be moved to lib/db/queries.ts public surface in a follow-up to keep server-action exports purely serializable.

Manual-group membership filtering on the catalog grid: Repo type does not carry groupIds, so selecting a manual group in the sidebar currently shows all repos. Smart groups work (filtered client-side via smartFilter). Recommend adding groupIds: number[] to Repo (contract v1.1) or a listReposByGroup query.

Hand-authored drizzle/0000_initial.sql (backend agent could not run drizzle-kit in sandbox). Future pnpm db:generate runs may produce 0001_*.sql duplicates. Either keep the hand-written migration as the canonical baseline (recommended) or have the operator run db:generate once and replace it.

gate_decision.reason: Build, typecheck, and unit-test gates all green. Contract diff clean. End-to-end smoke confirmed: POST /api/scan streams NDJSON correctly, GET /api/repos returns canonical Repo shape with tags/languages/dirty/branch metadata, heuristic tagger detects rust/toml from Cargo.toml. The four LOW-severity issues are post-MVP polish, not blockers. The MEDIUM issue (FTS quoting) is a known refinement and does not violate the contract — falls back gracefully to empty results. MVP is shippable on branch build/repo-hub-mvp.
